summary: Correct CI runtime selection after pinned rpds-py metadata rejects Python 3.10; retain Python 3.10 core coverage and require Python 3.11+ for the full validation set.

create.reason: Creation and audit share the skill compatibility declaration and Codex capability guidance. Distinguish standard-library helper Python 3.10 support from the pinned full validator environment requiring Python 3.11. No target templates, rule applicability, subject grading or dependency versions need changes.

verification.reason: All 146 local tests and the required-validator project check passed after the compatibility correction, including create/audit from the packaged runtime. Corrected remote CI remains a release gate rather than an inferred pass.
